treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1979)
eif_quote: Ratifikationsinstrumenten utväxlades i Stockholm den 8 oktober 1980. Avtalet trädde i kraft den 8 oktober 1980.
source_title: Prop. 1979/80:65 Om dubbelbeskattningsavtal mellan Sverige och Tjeckoslovakien (English and Swedish treaty text); SÖ 1980:12

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, the Contracting State of which the company is a resident shall not levy a tax on dividends paid by that company to a company the capital of which is wholly or partly divided into shares and which is a resident of the other Contracting State and holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends.
... and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

However, such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the law of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Treaty map: MLI WHT effect computed: SE reserved Art. 35(7)(a); no 35(7)(b) notification for this treaty found in OECD documents.

notes: Art. 28(2): provisions apply to income derived on or after 1 January of the year following the exchange of ratifications (exchanged 1980-10-08), i.e. from 1981-01-01. Dividend 0% (Art. 10(3)) for a company whose capital is wholly or partly divided into shares holding directly >=25% of the payer's capital; 10% otherwise. Royalties: 5% cap generally, but royalties for copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work taxable only in residence State (Art. 12(3)) - not modelled as separate tier. Interest exclusive to residence State. Treaty applies to the Czech Republic as successor of Czechoslovakia. Covered by MLI on both sides, but Sweden reserved Art. 35(7) and has not notified completion, so MLI (incl. PPT) not yet effective. Quotes from OCR text of the proposition with obvious OCR character errors corrected (e.g. 'lax'->'tax', 'nol'->'not').
